svg.title: How a request flows through LLMFlow
svg.desc: Your app sends an OpenAI-style request with an LLMFlow API key. LLMFlow checks the key and budget, serves repeats from cache, scores difficulty, picks the cheapest model that meets the quality setting, and falls back if a model fails. The request is answered by a provider using your own key: Groq, Gemini or OpenAI.
